research_mode: official Home Office, ONS and National Data Library sources only; PFA/CSP geography, rate calculation, revisions, classification breaks and rural-urban context; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Force-recorded area semantics
verified_claims: Force Name identifies the police force area in which an offence was recorded
the recorded force area will generally be the same area where the offence took place
limitations: generally does not mean always
recording area must not be treated as an exact incident coordinate

sources.name: CSP geography semantics
verified_claims: CSP Name identifies the Community Safety Partnership area in which offences were recorded
a CSP generally corresponds to single or combined local-authority boundaries
limitations: CSP boundaries are not parcel boundaries
combined-authority cases require the geographic reference table

sources.name: CSP-to-force geographic mapping
verified_claims: the geographic reference table maps each CSP to its police force area
the mapping is edition-specific reference data
limitations: mapping must be versioned with the release
names alone are not a stable join key

sources.name: CSP and force region mapping
verified_claims: the geographic reference table maps CSP and police-force areas to regions
region is a separate field from force and CSP
limitations: region aggregation must not replace lower-level geography
boundary changes require reference-table checks

sources.name: CSP ONS-code identifier
verified_claims: the geographic reference table includes an ONS Code for each CSP
the code is described as a unique CSP identifier
limitations: the code must be joined through the matching release
an ONS code is not a parcel or police-neighbourhood identifier

sources.name: PFA and CSP publication granularity
verified_claims: figures are provided at Police Force Area and Community Safety Partnership levels
the two products support different geographic analyses
limitations: PFA and CSP rows must not be mixed without explicit aggregation
neither level supplies parcel observations

sources.name: Multi-column and multi-sheet filtering
verified_claims: users may need to filter across multiple columns
different years can require searching across multiple sheets
limitations: single-sheet extraction can omit periods
filters must retain force CSP offence and period fields

sources.name: Additive quarterly figures
verified_claims: the guide states that figures in the tables are additive
quarterly offence figures can be aggregated when dimensions match
limitations: addition is valid only for non-overlapping periods and matching geography/offence definitions
rates and percentages are not additive

sources.name: Four-quarter annual aggregation
verified_claims: all four quarters of a 12-month financial period can be summed for a PFA
the aggregation uses the Financial Year and Financial Quarter fields
limitations: revised quarter editions must be consistent
rolling-12-month and financial-year totals must not be conflated

sources.name: CSP and national-total non-identity
verified_claims: CSP-level totals do not necessarily equal national police-recorded-crime totals
scope differences are an official caveat
limitations: a CSP sum must not be labelled as the national total without reconciliation
scope exclusions must remain explicit
